newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends higher on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends higher on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Wednesday on short-covering in an attempt to correct the recent downward slide, Japanese traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 2.9 yen per kg higher.
Benchmark December ended up 0.7 yen at 114.0 yen.

"Prices rose on short-covering driven by technical factors, there were no special positive factors," one analyst at a commodity broker said. Traders said further gains were likely to be limited. "It is too early to say the market has bottomed out since rubber consuming countries have been refraining from buying supplies in producing countries," he said.
